spanish: Y harán en día de su balancear el ómer cordero íntegro hijo de su año a holocausto a Jehová.

findings.issue: הָעֹמֶר is a common noun (article + H6016), rendered as the untranslated transliteration ómer instead of a Spanish common noun.

notes: 2mp weqatal and suffix read as ustedes (harán, su); את is unmarked.
